protocol.caveat: pre-registered: the window, the tolerance and the metric are fixed in this file, not chosen after seeing the numbers

resolution_trend_vs_independent.metric: mae/amplitude vs the independent transcription must not grow under refinement

compressibility.metric: max(rho/rho0 - 1) over the run, finest resolution

trajectory_vs_independent.metric: mae(Z/a) / amplitude, independent transcription, finest resolution

trajectory_vs_bundled.metric: mae(Z/a) / amplitude, bundled transcription, finest resolution
trajectory_vs_bundled.reason: the bundled table is graded WITHHELD by benchmarks/dam_break/reference_audit.json: its ordinates are exact multiples of 0.05 on an exact tau lattice, so it cannot arbitrate a tolerance; the number is recorded, not graded

verdict.interpretation: The two transcriptions of the same figure disagree by 0.851 in Z/a, i.e. 17.0x the uncertainty they claim, so the pair cannot both be right. The simulation is graded against the transcription whose structure survives the audit (pass at 4.376% of amplitude) and the bundled table is reported without a grade.
